source: Author requested four more brainstormed camp items, October 16, 2026. Proposed shell-and-metal everyday camp goods governed by Docs/WORLD_BASIS.md; no wood, ordinary cloth or natural-water process assumed.
scope: Four independent Camp items. Design proposals only; no runtime furniture, interactions, world placement, deterministic identity, streaming or persisted gameplay changes.

defaults.Carrier metadata: Physical camp inventory / cargo item; folded size, packing and placement unresolved.
defaults.Acquisition: Proposed contemporary fabrication or trade; availability and price unresolved.
defaults.Crafting / processing: Candidate assembly from qualified shell/metal stock and compatible fittings. No recipe, quantities, yields, dimensions or production time assigned.
defaults.Limitations: Fit, loads, stability, wear, dimensions and useful performance remain proposals. No wood, ordinary cloth, natural-water process, numerical bonus or new equipment slot established.
defaults.Classification basis: Independent everyday camp object; Camp items uses the shared filters and sort order without visible subsection grouping.
defaults.Tier basis: Proposed T2 assembly using qualified T1 stock and compatible fittings; actual recipe and qualification unresolved.

items.name: Folding shell stool
items.purpose: A shallow curved shell seat carried on a folding metal support. A compact sitting place for a settled camp, distinct from the existing ground-rest panel. Load, balance and fold retention remain design work.
items.icon: One low folding stool with a curved amber-brown shell seat, crossed dark-metal legs and visible hinge pins. No wooden parts, cloth, wearer or surrounding camp.

fields.Search aliases: camp chair; folding seat; shell stool; sitting
fields.Open design decisions: Seat curvature, leg spread, hinge stops, load, stability and folded packing remain unresolved. No rest recovery or comfort statistic assigned.

items.name: Folding camp table
items.purpose: Two hinged shell leaves form a small dining and sorting surface on folding metal legs. A camp furniture item distinct from the Workbench crafting station; it grants no crafting capability or extra storage.
items.icon: One compact folding table with two flat shell leaves, a visible center hinge and plain metal trestle legs. Empty surface, no wood, fabric, tools, food or full camp.

fields.Search aliases: camp dining table; folding table; shell tabletop; meal surface
fields.Open design decisions: Panel joining, fold locks, leg stability, load and folded volume remain unresolved. Not a crafting station, storage holder or additional inventory capacity.

items.name: Adjustable shell headrest
items.purpose: A smooth shallow shell saddle on a short notched metal support, intended to position the head above a camp resting surface. Separate from the existing ground-rest panel and bedding; canister clearance and useful support require design.
items.icon: One low headrest with a smooth curved shell saddle, two short metal feet and a small notched height adjuster. No pillow, ordinary cloth, wearer or sleeping platform.

fields.Search aliases: camp headrest; shell neck support; sleeping head support
fields.Open design decisions: Saddle shape, height adjustment, edge finishing, stability, wearer fit and personal canister clearance remain unresolved. No medical, sleep-quality or recovery benefit assigned.

items.name: Camp boot scraper
items.purpose: A low slotted metal scraping edge over a removable shell grit tray, intended to clear loose packed grit from footwear outside a shelter. Unlike the existing dust brush and folding grit pan, this is a fixed scraping fixture with its own catch tray.
items.icon: One low camp boot scraper with a blunt slotted dark-metal scraping bar, two broad feet and a shallow removable shell grit tray. No boot, wearer, brush, wood or full camp.

fields.Search aliases: sole scraper; footwear grit cleaner; camp boot cleaning; grit tray
fields.Open design decisions: Edge profile, tray retention, tipping resistance, cleaning and footwear compatibility remain unresolved. No footwear repair, durability recovery or mandatory cleaning chore established.
